messages:
Maria C.: quick check-in — NebulaCorp's dedicated pool goes live next week, want to lock quota, autoscale thresholds, and load test windows this hour?
Jae K.: I can cover autoscale settings. What's the expected QPS spike in cutover?
Lucas (NebulaCorp): current estimate ~120 rps steady, spike up to 400 rps for 2-3 minutes during promotional reroute.
Priya S.: ok. for GPUs we typically set scale-up trigger at 65% util and cool-down 90s. Scale-down at 30% with 300s stabilization. That worked for similar profiles.
Maria C.: noted. Customer asked for a hard quota for reserved pool to avoid noisy neighbors — asking for 10k tokens/sec equivalent on medium models. Thoughts?
Jae K.: we map token throughput to slot counts. 10k tokens/sec => ~6 slots at our baseline config. Recommend reserving 8 slots to allow headroom and autoscale bursts.
Tom R.: +1 to headroom. Also suggest enabling short-lived burst capacity (ephemeral spot slots) for the 400rps spike, with fallback to smaller model if capacity exhausted.
Lucas (NebulaCorp): fallback to smaller model is acceptable but they want no more than 2s p95 if possible.
Priya S.: with 8 reserved + 4 burst slots we should hit ~1.6s p95 on med-latency models in staging. We'll need KV cache warmup for prefix-heavy requests.
Maria C.: action items: Priya to prepare autoscale policy JSON, Jae to compute exact slot->token mapping + reserve 8 slots, Tom to enable burst policy and define fallback model, and Lucas to confirm maintenance blackout windows.
Priya S.: putting autoscale snippet here for review:
```
{"scale_up_threshold":65, "scale_up_cooldown_s":90, "scale_down_threshold":30, "scale_down_cooldown_s":300, "min_slots":8, "max_slots":20, "burst_enabled":true}
```
Jae K.: I'll run capacity calc and post numbers in 30m.
Lucas (NebulaCorp): maintenance blackout is 03:00-06:00 UTC only. cutover planned 2026-04-02 14:00 UTC.
Maria C.: load test window: 2026-04-02 13:00-13:45 UTC (gradual ramp then spike at 13:30). Can SRE join and own runbook?
Jae K.: SRE will own runbook. I'll add canary checks, traffic shift steps, and rollback criteria (error rate >2% sustained 2min or p95 >3s).
Tom R.: adding one more rollback condition: sustained queue depth >50 for >3min.
Priya S.: I'll also push a KV pre-warm job 15m before cutover (script below).
```
# prewarm pseudocode
for prefix in top_200_prompts:
  send(dummy_request(prefix, traces=false))
```
deploy-bot: deployment plan for reserved pool "nebula-reserved-v1" created by Priya S. — https://deploys.internal/nebula-reserved-v1
Maria C.: perfect. I'll send a runbook summary to Lucas and schedule a dry run on 2026-03-30 14:00 UTC. Any blockers?
Lucas (NebulaCorp): none on our side, just need a short enablement call for our infra team on 03-30.
Maria C.: noted. I'll book 30m enablement and share the runbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jae K.: I'll post capacity numbers shortly.
Priya S.: prepping autoscale and prewarm scripts now.
Tom R.: enabling burst policy flag in staging and setting alerts.
Maria C.: closing thread, will follow up with calendar invite and runbook link.
